charge_port.notes: Lucid: the Air has a J1772 (CCS1) combo port.

supercharger_access.notes: Lucid (Canada and US pages): Tesla Superchargers (V3+) with a Lucid-approved NACS-to-CCS1 adapter ($220); access opened 31 July 2025 for every Air (Electrek 2026 Air article).

wheels.notes: Carried from the 2022 Grand Touring listing; the 2023 page does not list these trims. Neighbouring years disagree: 2022 Grand Touring 21 inch, 2024 Grand Touring 20 inch; the 2023 size could be either.
